lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Yeah, it's okay.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: These days, you can't get by on singing and dancing alone.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: This can be our chance. With Tetra's support, we can finally shape our individual image.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Then, we might actually make a name for ourselves, and a proper debut wouldn't feel so out of reach anymore.
I-I'm going to spray this on your face now.
Wh-when I do, make sure you thank me and smile, okay?
O-okay, and rolling.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Check the forums. These days, there's not a single person who doesn't know us. We're basically celebrities now.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: There are way more Smile Time posts than T.T. STAR posts, but it's really all the same, so it doesn't matter.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Smiling is easy, and the fans keep saying my smile is pretty.
My boss looks a lot like you, Mint. Your eyes look almost identical.
I confessed to her, but she reacted as if she was disgusted and turned me down. Then the rumors spiraled out of control, and I ended up quitting.
I don't think it's right to trample on someone's feelings like that. So, apologize to me.
Tell me you actually liked me, that you only turned me down because you had your reasons, and say it with a smile.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: This is the only way. It's the only way someone like us can ever stand out...

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: I just have to smile more. They say I look better when I do... the fans, I mean.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: That's why they're here to see me, right? Because I look pretty when I smile.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: So go on, watch me smile as much as you like...
Mint, you're actually terrible. You've got nothing going for you except your pretty face.
Don't you think you're kind of a burden?
You don't even practice in front of the mirror, do you? You just stare at yourself and think, "Yeah, I'm pretty. I don't need to practice."
Hahaha, this is fun. You're re having fun too, right? That's why you're smiling with me.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Honestly, I didn't push myself that hard. Compared to Anis and Prika, I had it easy.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: So I'm fine. If it ends up like this, so be it. Maybe this is the price for trying to reach the top without earning it.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: But those two are different. They worked for it. They gave everything they had. They deserve respect.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Don't touch them. If you do, I swear I'll make you regret it. Don't you dare drag their names through the dirt.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Come to me. Come closer.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Look at me smiling. Isn't my smile pretty? That's right, so come to me.
So what exactly are you good at, Mint?
You're a worse dancer than Prika, and your singing doesn't measure up to Anis either.
Other than your looks, you don't really have anything going for you. So why are you even trying to be a pop star?
Come on, I'm kidding. Smile a little.
See? You look so much prettier when you smile.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Sparkle, sparkle...

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Haha, so pretty. We're shining so brightly right now, aren't we?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Bright enough for anyone to see, no matter where they are...

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Right? That's true, right?

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: No, we're not shining at all. This isn't what it means to shine.

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Sparkle, sparkle...

lines.speaker: mint_o
lines.text: Hello, I'm Mint. Would you like to see me smile?
Prika has everything going for her, but her expression is too cold.
That's why you look best when you smile, so smile more.
There you go. Stretch your mouth until it's about to split. Yeah, just like that.
Gosh, you look so silly. It's adorable.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I hate this. I really hate it. I don't want to do this kind of stuff.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I just want to dance and sing. Why am I even here doing this?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: What even is this? What's "Smile Time"? Why are we doing this crap?
I want you out of T.T. STAR.
Honestly, you ruin the lineup. You don't even fit the group. You're freakishly tall and not even cute.
This is seriously irritating, so can you smile and apologize?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: What even is this? Seriously, how is this supposed to help us?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Stop. Just stop. Let's start over from scratch.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Yeah, from the beginning. That's the right call. We don't even need to push it this far.
You almost debuted back when you were human, didn't you? Then you died in that accident.
Honestly? That might've been the best thing that ever happened to you. I looked up your clips, and you have zero talent.
At least now that you're a Nikke, you're barely passable. Back then? You were just pathetic.
So go on. Smile, and thank Anis and Mint. Thank them for letting you debut at all.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I see, so you can't give up.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Even if it's pointless, you're still clinging to it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: You think this is your only shot, and that there won't be a second chance for us.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: ... You're that desperate.
T.T. STAR is going to flop. Groups that blow up on cheap gimmicks like this never last.
If you want to survive, you should start relying on actual skill. This kind of noise marketing? It's embarrassing.
When I was younger, I worked until my nose bled. That's how I earned my place.
This is my book. Read from cover to cover, and I'll be back tomorrow to test you on it. Don't disappoint me.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Yeah, I'll do it. I'm in. I'll smile.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Not for them. For you.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: You really think that if we keep this up, we'll get what we want?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Then I'll believe it too.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Come on, let's smile for my friends, for the team.
Seriously, what a joke. You just go around smiling like that all day?
How do you even live like that? Must be desperate as hell just to get by.
If that were me, I'd rather kill myself. Seriously, do you not have any pride?

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Lift the corners of your mouth gently. Don't force it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: This is so stupid. What even is this? I wanna bail.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Ease your eyes down a little, but not too much. Just enough for a soft curve.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I hate this. Seriously, I hate this.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Too much and it'll look fake. Keep it subtle. Stay in character. Yeah, that's it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: I hate it. I hate it. I hate it.

lines.speaker: prika_o
lines.text: Smile. Smile. Smile.
You said you were bullied. What did that feel like?
How did you feel back then? Did it make you resent the world?
Did the thought of dying ever cross your mind?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Hold it in. Hold it in. Just hold it in.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Mint and Prika are holding it together too. I'm the leader. I can't be the one who screws this up.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: They must have it worse than me.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But neither of them's saying we should quit. That's probably because of me.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: You stuck with me when I had nothing. I was too embarrassed to ever say it, but thank you, really.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'm sorry, guys. And thank you. I can keep going because you're here.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: We all know we're not special.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But this is how we get there, so let's believe in that. We'll believe that. We have to. We will.
Thank goodness...
My life's been such a mess, and it's been exhausting.
But seeing you? It actually makes me feel better.
So please, stay right where you are at the bottom. I need someone like you to remind me there's still hope.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: But if we keep this up, will it really make us special?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Wait, we went up again. 6th? You've got to be kidding me.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yeah, just hang in there. Once we break into the mainstream, it'll all sort itself out.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: We'll make all this stupid crap worth it.
I've been a fan since your Meet & Meat days, but what a letdown.
So in the end, you're just like every other pop star, huh? Pulling cheap stunts like this for attention.
Say you're sorry. Apologize for disappointing me
and for wasting my support and my time. Oh, and smile while you're at it.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Why am I even doing this again?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Oh right, I wanted to be like Pretty. I wanted to give people hope.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I wanted to become a star.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: If I do this, I can become one, right?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I can, right? I mean, that is why I'm doing this, right?
Be honest. You're the one who exposed Yoyo's past, right?
I heard she bullied you pretty badly. So that was payback, wasn't it?
Clever. You drag Yoyo down, pick up sympathy votes, and ride that all the way to the top.
Wow, pop stars these days really have to be smart. Oh right, you're just trash, not a pop star.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Yeah, it'll help. It will. It has to.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Our ranking shot up, and more people know us now.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Love's still love, right? Even like this.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: So we should be grateful. We should. Thanks.
I looked up every T.T. STAR video I could find.
Hmm... And if I'm being honest?
You all have zero talent, especially you, Anis. Do you even have any respect for what you do?
Your singing, your dancing, your stage presence, your whole persona... It's all painfully mediocre. No wonder you resort to cheap stunts like this.
Damnit, this pisses me off. You've completely ruined my mood, so I think I deserve some compensation.
Why don't you lift your skirt a little? Just a bit.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Thank you for loving me. I wanted that more than anything.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'll do better. I swear I will. I'll become a star and give back all the love I've been given.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: To those of you who fell into despair, who felt like giving up,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'll tell you it's okay to keep living.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'll be there for you when you're lonely, when you're exhausted.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: And in the end,

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: I'll make sure you feel like staying alive was the right choice.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: G-good work today, everyone.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-I got loads of snacks for you, and um... some new bath bombs too.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Oh, and I've also changed all the bedding, and... um...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Y-you made it to number 4 on the indie charts. They're saying they've never seen a climb this fast before.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: I-it's all thanks to you guys working so hard. Y-you've really done an amazing job...
The room is completely silent.
They sit scattered across beds, chairs, and the floor, staring blankly into space.
Two weeks have passed since the Smile Time project began.
Turned into toys for the masses, T.T. STAR is already breaking apart.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Um... guys?

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Huh? Yeah, what's up?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Should we stop?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Let's stop.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: We all know this isn't right.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Let's just stop.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: How... do we even stop this...?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: We can deal with the penalties later.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Just set that aside for now.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: First, we need to get out of here.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: We might have to start over from nothing, and maybe we won't ever make it back as pop stars...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: But... this isn't right.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: So please... let's stop.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: What about Boss...?

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Still... no word.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: He's not... picking up either...
Anis looks at Mint and Prika.
They meet her eyes.
And only now, it hits her...
It's too late.
She should have said something sooner.

lines.speaker: anis_idol
lines.text: Can we stop...?
*Beep*
Her phone vibrates.
She glances at the screen.
A notification pops up: they've hit No. 1 on the indie charts.
Everyone looks at one another.
Just one more step,
and they'll finally break into the mainstream they've been chasing for so long.
Anis turns to Riss.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Anis...
Riss scans the group,
studying their expressions.

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: Then...

lines.speaker: riss
lines.text: just a little longer... just a little more...
Silence hangs over the dorm once more.
A faint, relentless biting sound breaks the silence.
The room is dark. The only light comes from Yoyo's phone.
She stares at the screen and chews her nails down to nothing as if she can tear through the display with sheer will.
It's the indie charts.
T.T. STAR sits at number one.
She refreshes. Again. And again.
The ranking doesn't change.
She refreshes again.
Still nothing changes.
*Crunch, crunch, crunch*
The sound of her nails being gnawed raw fills the darkness again and again, the only thing breaking the silence.
